proposals.before: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows vanish; yang qi ascends; yin qi descends; the world seals into winter. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds fall silent; tigers begin to mate; winter wheat sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms coil; elk shed antlers; springs begin to flow.
proposals.after: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows vanish; yang qi ascends; yin qi descends; the world seals into winter. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds fall silent; tigers begin to mate; the liting plant sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms coil; elk shed antlers; springs begin to flow.
proposals.reason: Chinese 荔挺出 names the liting rush/iris plant sprouting, not winter wheat.

proposals.before: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows hide and are not seen; heaven's qi rises; earth's qi descends; obstruction closes and winter forms. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds do not cry; tigers first mate; winter wheat sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms knot; elk antlers shed; spring waters stir.
proposals.after: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows hide and are not seen; heaven's qi rises; earth's qi descends; obstruction closes and winter forms. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds do not cry; tigers first mate; the liting plant sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms knot; elk antlers shed; spring waters stir.
proposals.reason: Chinese 荔挺出 is the liting plant sprouting; "winter wheat" invents a different plant.

proposals.before: (After the winter solstice the sun slows; after the summer solstice it speeds up.)
proposals.after: (After the winter solstice, expansion; after the summer solstice, contraction.)
proposals.reason: Chinese 盈/縮 are the expansion and contraction sequences; "slows/speeds up" reverses and invents a physical gloss not in the source.

proposals.after: To compute the four seasonal solar degrees at midnight before dawn
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn, not dawn before midnight.

proposals.after: To seek the four cardinals' solar degrees at midnight before dawn

proposals.after: To compute the daily ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn after each seasonal node

proposals.before: To seek each day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight after the four cardinals
proposals.after: To seek each day's ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn after the four cardinals
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; the English reverses the modifiers.

proposals.before: Let the interval in days run from one seasonal node's true date to the next, and the interval in degrees from one dawn-before-midnight position to the next; accumulate the sun's fixed daily motion over those days and subtract from the degree interval;
proposals.after: Let the interval in days run from one seasonal node's true date to the next, and the interval in degrees from one midnight-before-dawn position to the next; accumulate the sun's fixed daily motion over those days and subtract from the degree interval;
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; "dawn-before-midnight" reverses the phrase.

proposals.before: Take the four cardinals' fixed qi day to the next fixed qi day as the separation in days; take the four cardinals' fixed qi solar degree at dawn before midnight to the next as the separation in degrees; accumulate the fixed daily motion over the separation days and subtract from the separation in degrees;
proposals.after: Take the four cardinals' fixed qi day to the next fixed qi day as the separation in days; take the four cardinals' fixed qi solar degree at midnight before dawn to the next as the separation in degrees; accumulate the fixed daily motion over the separation days and subtract from the separation in degrees;
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; the English reverses the modifiers.

proposals.before: Accumulate from each seasonal node's dawn-before-midnight position, discarding full lodge cycles, to obtain the ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight for every day.
proposals.after: Accumulate from each seasonal node's midnight-before-dawn position, discarding full lodge cycles, to obtain the ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn for every day.
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; both occurrences reverse the phrase.

proposals.before: Add cumulatively from the four cardinals' ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight; when it fills the lodge sequence, remove it—this is each day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight and parts and seconds.
proposals.after: Add cumulatively from the four cardinals' ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn; when it fills the lodge sequence, remove it—this is each day's ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn and parts and seconds.
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; both occurrences reverse the modifiers.

proposals.before: Halve the true daily motion and add it to that day's dawn-before-midnight ecliptic position to obtain the noon ecliptic position.
proposals.after: Halve the true daily motion and add it to that day's midnight-before-dawn ecliptic position to obtain the noon ecliptic position.
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; "dawn-before-midnight" reverses the phrase.

proposals.before: Set its fixed daily motion; halve it; add to that day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight—this yields the ecliptic solar degree at noon and parts and seconds.
proposals.after: Set its fixed daily motion; halve it; add to that day's ecliptic solar degree at midnight before dawn—this yields the ecliptic solar degree at noon and parts and seconds.
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; the English reverses the modifiers.

proposals.before: Entering the Ziwei station; the chronogram branch is hai (Pig).
proposals.after: Entering the Juzi station; the chronogram branch is hai (Pig).
proposals.reason: Chinese 娵訾 is the Juzi (Zouzi) Jupiter station, not Ziwei (紫微).

proposals.before: Entering the Ziwei division; the chronogram is in hai.
proposals.after: Entering the Juzi division; the chronogram is in hai.
proposals.reason: Chinese 娵訾 is Juzi/Zouzi, not Ziwei.

proposals.before: For each station, take its entry lodge position and subtract that day's dawn-before-midnight solar degree; multiply the remainder by the day divisor to form the dividend;
proposals.after: For each station, take its entry lodge position and subtract that day's midnight-before-dawn solar degree; multiply the remainder by the day divisor to form the dividend;
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; "dawn-before-midnight" reverses the phrase.

proposals.before: For each, set the lodge degree and parts and seconds at station entry; subtract the day's solar degree at dawn before midnight; multiply the remainder by the day circuit—this is the dividend;
proposals.after: For each, set the lodge degree and parts and seconds at station entry; subtract the day's solar degree at midnight before dawn; multiply the remainder by the day circuit—this is the dividend;
proposals.reason: 晨前夜半 means midnight preceding dawn; the English reverses the modifiers.

proposals.before: White Dew, eighth-month minor term: wild geese arrive; dark birds return; flocking birds store provisions. Autumn Equinox, eighth-month mid-term: thunder first ceases; hibernating creatures damage their doors; water first dries up. Ninth month.
proposals.after: White Dew, eighth-month minor term: wild geese arrive; dark birds depart homeward; flocking birds store provisions. Autumn Equinox, eighth-month mid-term: thunder first ceases; hibernating creatures seal their burrows; water first dries up. Ninth month.
proposals.reason: 玄鳥歸 means swallows return south/depart, and 壞戶 means sealing burrows, not damaging doors.

proposals.before: Within each solstice half-year: below the quadrant limit counts as the initial segment; above it, subtract the half-year circuit to obtain the final segment.
proposals.after: Within each solstice half-year: below the quadrant limit counts as the initial segment; above it, subtract from the half-year circuit to obtain the final segment.
proposals.reason: 末限 uses the 用減/反減 pattern: when above the quadrant, the final limit is the half-year circuit minus the accumulated degree, not subtracting the half-year circuit from that degree.

proposals.before: After the equatorial true node the moon is north of the equator; after the middle node it is south.
proposals.after: After the equatorial true node the moon is south of the equator (outer); after the middle node it is north (inner).
proposals.reason: 外/內 polarity is reversed: s0314 內減外加象限 shows 內 yields polar distance below 90° (north of the equator) and 外 above 90° (south), so 正交後為外 is south and 中交後為內 is north.

proposals.before: Take the fixed limit degree, multiply it by the difference between the initial and final limits, shift the decimal place to obtain parts, and derive the fixed difference;
proposals.after: Take the fixed limit degree together with the applicable initial or final limit, subtract one from the other and multiply; shift one place to obtain parts—this is the fixed difference;
proposals.reason: 相減相乘 couples 定限度 with the single applicable 初末限 value; it is not the difference between an initial limit and a final limit.

proposals.before: multiply the fixed limit degree by the difference between the initial and final limits, shift the decimal place to parts, convert parts to degrees when they reach 100, and obtain the fixed difference;）
proposals.after: take the initial or final limit with the fixed limit degree, subtract one from the other and multiply; shift one place to parts; when parts reach 100 convert to degrees—this is the fixed difference;）
proposals.reason: Same 相減相乘 error as s0316: 初末限與定限度 are paired, not an initial-versus-final difference.

proposals.before: subtract the dawn-dusk lodge positions before and after each true event and divide the difference by the number of intervening days to obtain the daily correction;
proposals.after: subtract that accumulated rotation arc from the degree of separation between the dawn-dusk lodge positions before and after each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon, and divide the remainder by the number of intervening days to obtain the daily correction;
proposals.reason: Chinese pairs 轉積度 with 定朔弦望晨昏宿次前後相距度; the idiomatic omits the rotation accumulation as the other term of 相減.

decisions.reason: s0080 荔挺出 names the phenological sprouting of the liting plant; "winter wheat" invents a different plant not in the Chinese.
The same 荔挺出 error appears in the literal field; replacing "winter wheat sprouts" with "the liting plant sprouts" restores the source plant.
s0106 冬至後盈，夏至後縮 names the expansion and contraction sequences; "slows/speeds up" is an invented physical gloss not supported by the Chinese.
s0164 晨前夜半 is midnight preceding dawn; "dawn before midnight" reverses the modifiers.
Literal 晨前夜半 likewise means midnight before dawn, not dawn before midnight.
s0170 晨前夜半日度 is the solar degree at midnight preceding dawn; the idiomatic reverses the phrase.
Literal 晨前夜半日度 has the same reversed English modifiers.
s0171 每日晨前夜半黃道日度 is the daily ecliptic degree at midnight before dawn.
Literal field repeats the same 晨前夜半 modifier reversal.
s0172 晨前夜半日度 denotes midnight-before-dawn positions; "dawn-before-midnight" reverses the Chinese.
Literal 晨前夜半日度 needs the same midnight-before-dawn correction.
s0177 uses 晨前夜半 twice; both English occurrences reverse midnight preceding dawn.
Literal likewise reverses both 晨前夜半 occurrences.
s0179 晨前夜半黃道日度 is the midnight-before-dawn ecliptic position added to half the daily motion.
Literal 晨前夜半 has the same reversed modifiers.
s0188 娵訾 is the Juzi Jupiter station; Ziwei (紫微) is a different name invented by the translation.
Literal 娵訾 likewise cannot be Ziwei; Juzi restores the station name.
s0212 晨前夜半日度 is midnight preceding dawn; "dawn-before-midnight" reverses it.
Literal 晨前夜半日度 needs the same midnight-before-dawn correction.
s0076 玄鳥歸 is the dark birds' homeward departure, and 壞戶 is sealing burrows; "return" alone and "damage their doors" misread both phrases.
s0283 已上，減去半歲周，為末限 yields the final limit as half-year circuit minus the accumulated degree (用減), not value minus half-year circuit.
